title: nos.tlplotR: Visualize Newcastle-Ottawa Scale Risk-of-Bias Assessments with 'nos-tlplot'
description:
nos.tlplotR is an R interface to the Python package nos-tlplot. It creates publication-ready traffic-light plots and thirteen specialized visualizations for Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) risk-of-bias assessments in systematic reviews and meta-analyses, including domain and theme radars, item-level star heatmaps, stacked star profiles, donut charts, lollipop charts, star matrices and the NOS visualization grid.

Plots are produced by nos-tlplot through the reticulate package.
